changeSet.sql: -- Find the maximum existing SERVICEID SELECT @max_serviceid := MAX(SERVICEID) FROM tblmclientservice;

-- Insert duplicate records with incremented SERVICEID starting from @max_serviceid + 1 INSERT INTO tblmclientservice (SERVICEID, NAME, VALUE, MVNOID) SELECT IFNULL((SELECT MAX(SERVICEID) FROM tblmclientservice), @max_serviceid) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SERVICEID) AS SERVICEID, NAME, VALUE, 1 AS MVNOID FROM tblmclientservice WHERE MVNOID='2';
-- Optional: View the inserted duplicate records SELECT * FROM tblmclientservice WHERE SERVICEID > @max_serviceid;

changeSet.author: Akshay Mewada
changeSet.sql: DELETE t1 FROM tblmclientservice t1 JOIN ( SELECT name, MVNOID, MAX(serviceid) AS max_serviceid FROM tblmclientservice GROUP BY name, MVNOID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) t2 ON t1.name = t2.name AND t1.MVNOID = t2.MVNOID AND t1.serviceid < t2.max_serviceid;
